snippet.title: Disease – Teaser Trailer | Visual Novel
snippet.description:
A high school student dreams the crimes of a serial killer in his hometown. He wants to help the police catch the monster, but doing so may put him in the killer’s shoes.

***
Disease is a psychological horror visual novel.
Developer: Pumpkin4Sale – Oleg Sputnikov
Release date: TBA 2026
